title: p256-ecdlp: odd-lift BSGS with cross-page planted-base MSD distribution

claims.statement: For uniform x in [0,r), input Q=[x]P on NIST P-256 with the profile generator P, the deterministic odd-lift baby-step/giant-step procedure in proof.md recovers x with probability 1. Baby records are sorted by a cross-page planted-base MSD byte distribution with no heap. Total classical work is strictly less than 2^133 target-group-operation equivalents at C=1000, including preprocessing, sorting, lookup, verification and failed-path charging. Peak memory is strictly less than 2^135 bytes. Preprocessing is strictly less than 2^132 target-group-operation equivalents and is included in the total. Nonuniform advice is 0 bytes. No heuristic premise, quantum step or uncharged table is used.

experiments.purpose: Exhaustively recover every scalar on a prime-order toy curve with the odd-lift decomposition, and check that planted-base MSD sorting is a permutation onto sorted order with cross-page scatters. This does not measure production instruction counts or memory.
